faq.pageSub: Answers to the most common questions from our customers.

items.a1: We supply air conditioners, aircond parts, spare parts, accessories, installation materials and electrical components from leading brands.
items.a2: We supply Daikin, Midea, Panasonic, AUX, Acson, Haier, Hisense, TCL and more.
items.q3: Do you sell aircond spare parts?
items.a3: Yes — we stock a comprehensive range of compressors, PCB boards, fan motors, capacitors, sensors and more.
items.a4: Yes. We offer competitive wholesale pricing for installers, contractors and bulk buyers.
items.q5: Can I request a bulk quotation?
items.a5: Yes — please submit a project enquiry via our Project Supply page or contact us directly.
items.q6: Can I upload a photo to identify a spare part?
items.a6: Yes — use our Quick Photo Enquiry on the homepage to upload a photo and we'll identify it for you.
items.q7: Can I send a product video?
items.a7: Yes — you can upload a short video along with your enquiry to help us understand the product.
items.a8: Yes — we work closely with installers, HVAC contractors and electrical contractors.
items.a9: Yes — we provide bulk quotations and project supply for commercial buildings, offices and developments.
items.q10: Do you serve customers outside Kedah?
items.a10: Yes — we serve customers nationwide across Malaysia, not only in Kedah.
items.a11: Yes — our service area is all of Malaysia, with branches in Padang Serai, Sungai Petani and Kulim.
items.a12: Our HQ is in Padang Serai, with branches in Sungai Petani and Kulim (all in Kedah).

callForEnquiry: If you need more information about product availability, specifications or pricing, feel free to call us.
